data: Tesla's fiscal 2025 results show a business under margin pressure while it steps up investment. Revenue fell to $94.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024, a decline of 2.9%. Gross profit held up better, slipping to $17.1 billion from $17.4 billion, which leaves a fiscal 2025 gross margin of 18.0%. The damage came further down the income statement. Operating income dropped to $4.4 billion in fiscal 2025 from $7.1 billion in fiscal 2024, compressing operating margin to 4.6%. The main driver was R&D expense, which rose to $6.4 billion from $4.5 billion. Net income fell 46.5% to $3.8 billion from $7.1 billion, and diluted EPS declined to $1.08 from $2.04. Investors are effectively funding Tesla's future bets at the expense of near-term profitability.
